caption: The drawing depicts a wooden platform with a central vertical post supporting a horizontal wooden beam near the top, to which two human figures are affixed by their necks and wrists, restrained in stocks. These two figures have brown heads and green-and-black vertically striped bodies, and are positioned facing downward with their heads and hands extending through holes in the stocks. Another figure stands at the base of the platform facing the post, with a brown head and yellow-and-black vertically striped body. Two figures dressed in black suits with bowler hats, white shirts, and green ties are positioned at the base of the platform; one is holding a stick or cane and the other is reaching toward the restrained figure at the base. A wooden ladder leans against the platform on the right side. The platform and post are colored in brown tones to resemble wood, and the words "DELAWARE JUSTICE" are inscribed in black on the front-facing edge of the platform. The drawing is rendered in a realistic style with careful shading to depict the three-dimensional form of the objects. The background is white and unadorned.
title: Whipping Post
